# Smart Pharma System

> High-performance pharmaceutical management enterprise system for inventory, production, dispatch, task tracking, and salary management.

## System Modules
- **Dashboard**: Real-time company statistics, task progress, and user status.
- **Client Company**: Manage client companies and product specifications.
- **Tasks**: Assign, track, and verify daily production tasks.
- **Inventory**: Foil and cylinder stock monitoring with barcode scanning.
- **Dispatch**: Track shipments, invoices, and delivery status.
- **Finance & P&L**: Profit and loss overview, transaction logs, and revenue.
- **Attendance & Leave**: Geofenced check-in, leave requests, and attendance logs.
- **Reports**: Daily production, foil usage, and advance salary reports.
